Contact
402-245-3511
a.bartek@richardsoncountyne.gov
Office Hours
8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.
Monday – Friday
Usually open through the lunch hour
Closed Weekends and Holidays
VIN inspections are based on staffing and no inspections after 4:00 pm
Address
1700 Stone St, Room 105
Falls City, NE 68355
Driver’s License Examinations
402-245-2772
Wednesday
9:30 am – 12:00 pm
1:00 pm – 4:00 pm
Treasurer Office
Duties
To collect all revenue for the County
To disburse collections to the proper political subdivisions
To bill and collect all real estate, personal and drainage taxes in the County
To issue motor vehicle titles
To register and collect sales tax on all motor vehicles with tax situs in the County
To issue boat registrations
To accept payment and print driver licenses, CDL licenses, learners permits, ID cards and school permits
To administer the Public Tax Sale every March and issue private and county tax sales on unpaid taxes
DMV Services is a Department of the State of Nebraska that is operated by the Treasurer Office.
